notes.title: ANZ Indiefest 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275841/351a38174f5e1e81f4108a54fc9526b7d56c0e75.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Crikey![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]We're featured in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/anzindiefest2025"]ANZ Indiefest 2025[/url] presented by the lovely legends at [url="https://theindiebrew.com.au/"]The Indie Brew[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Checkout our updated Store Page with new details about Chessplus: Combine + Conquer and don't forget to look at the other rad Aussie and Kiwi made games. [/p][p][/p][p]In some exciting news for our small team, this is our first festival we're a part of that has main page featuring. Cheers to that![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275841/97d9a3fa25b8d88e89b0edf95e596a6fd561eced.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We're a small team and love hearing feedback and responding to your questions. Please let us know in the comments below if you have any questions.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Cheers,
Josh[/p]

notes.title: New Trailer + Our First Steam Festival!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275841/e976409b03353ceeb1e5e86c8fced0986f6f33b0.png"][/img][/p][p]G'day everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're extremely excited to announce that Chessplus has been featured in our first Steam Festival, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44695353/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"]Back to School Games Celebration 2025[/url], hosted by Lofi Girl / Mooncube Games (creators of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113850/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions/?snr=1_5_9_"]Spirit City: Lofi Sessions[/url]).[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate we've dropped a new trailer on the Steam page  and on YouTube for you all to enjoy.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ur5yLMRHqo0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Please let us know what you think! We're a small team and love hearing feedback and responding to your questions.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Josh[/p]
